acf.procut: Insulation Gasket and Flange Insulation Gasket Kits – Manufacturer & Supplier Flange insulation gasket is a specialized sealing component designed to electrically isolate flanges, prevent galvanic corrosion, and ensure leak-proof performance in pipelines and process systems.  Asian Sealing Products manufactures high-performance flange insulation gasket and complete flange insulation gasket kits engineered for reliable sealing and long-term flange protection. Our products are designed for use in demanding industries such as oil & gas, petrochemical, chemical processing, power generation, and pipeline systems. Our insulation gaskets are sized according to relevant international flange specifications, including ANSI, API, DIN, BS, AS, and MSSP. Our flange insulation gasket kits are designed to suit ASME B16.5 Raised Face (RF), Full Face (FF), and Ring Type Joint (RTJ) flanges, ensuring precise fitment and consistent performance across a wide range of pressure classes and service conditions. Manufactured using advanced insulating materials and supplied as complete, ready-to-install assemblies, our flange insulation gasket kits include insulation gaskets, insulating sleeves, washers, and backing washers. With a strong focus on quality, customization, and compliance, we deliver dependable insulation gasket solutions for both standard and custom flange applications worldwide.

acf.application_description: Insulation gaskets are widely used across industries that demand reliable sealing and electrical isolation. Their versatility and durability make them ideal for various challenging environments. Below are some of the key sectors where flange insulation gaskets are commonly applied:

gasket_applications.gasket_applications_sub_points:
• Sealing joints in chemical reactors
  • Flange connections in chemical plants

• Corrosion Prevention in Pipe Systems
  • Leak Prevention in High-Pressure Zones

acf.gaskets_materials_descriptions: Asian Sealing Products manufactures flange insulation gasket using carefully selected insulating materials to suit different pressure classes, temperatures, and chemical environments. Our insulation gasket solutions are produced using both non-metallic and laminated composite materials, selected based on application requirements. The choice of insulation gasket material plays a critical role in sealing performance, electrical isolation, mechanical strength, and long-term durability, especially in high-pressure and corrosive service conditions.

gaskets_materials_types.gaskets_materials_types_content: Phenolic insulation gaskets offer good mechanical strength and electrical insulation, making them suitable for general industrial applications. They are commonly used in low to medium-pressure flange connections.

This material combines a phenolic core with a neoprene sealing surface, providing improved sealing performance and resistance to minor flange surface irregularities. It is widely used in flange insulation gasket kits where enhanced sealing reliability is required.

G10 and G11 insulation gaskets provide high mechanical strength, excellent electrical insulation, and superior temperature resistance. These materials are ideal for high-pressure and high-temperature applications in oil & gas and petrochemical industries.
GRE insulation gaskets offer excellent chemical resistance and dimensional stability, making them suitable for aggressive service conditions and corrosive environments.
PTFE insulation gaskets provide outstanding chemical resistance and low-friction properties. They are commonly used in applications involving aggressive chemicals or where high purity is required.
We also offer custom insulation gasket materials tailored to specific operating conditions, flange standards, and customer requirements.

acf.gaskets_types_descriptions: Asian Sealing Products manufactures multiple insulation gasket configurations, developed to match specific flange designs, pressure classes, and operating environments. Each type is engineered to provide reliable isolation, sealing performance, and compliance with international standards. These flange insulation gasket types are selected based on application requirements to ensure dependable isolation, corrosion control, and sealing efficiency.

products_details.products_details_tilte: What Does a Complete Insulation Gasket Kit from Asian Sealing Products Include?
products_details.products_details_descriptions:
A complete insulation gasket kit from Asian Sealing Products is designed to provide reliable flange isolation, corrosion protection, and leak-free sealing in a single, ready-to-install package. Each flange insulation gasket kit is engineered for performance, durability, and ease of installation in industrial piping systems. Standard Components of an Insulation Gasket Kit
  • Insulating Gasket Precision-engineered insulation gasket designed to deliver effective sealing and electrical isolation between flanged connections.
  • Insulating Sleeves Non-conductive sleeves installed over the bolts to prevent metal-to-metal contact and eliminate electrical current flow.
  • Insulating Washers High-strength, non-conductive washers placed on either side of the flange to maintain complete electrical isolation.
  • Metal Backup Washers Steel backup washers that provide mechanical support and protect insulating washers during bolt tightening.
Materials and Customization Options Each flange insulation gasket kit is manufactured using high-quality, corrosion-resistant materials such as G10, G11, PTFE, and epoxy-coated metals, selected based on pressure, temperature, and chemical exposure. ASP insulation kits are available in Type F (Full Face), Type E, and Type D configurations and can be customized to suit ANSI, DIN, ASME, and other international flange specifications.

products_details.products_details_tilte: TYPE E (Full Face Type Gasket) Insulation Gasket
products_details.products_details_descriptions:
• Complete electrical isolation
  • Enhanced sealing coverage across the entire flange face, including flange bolts
  • Prevents flange face corrosion and fluid leakage
  • Comes with the same outside diameter as the flanges. Hence, the foreign material collection between the flange faces is prevented
  • Ideal for high-pressure and corrosive environments
  • Suitable for flat face and raised face flanges
  • The E gaskets are available in plain-faced Phenolic, Neoprene-faced Phenolic, and high temperature material like G-10 that offer excellent mechanical strength, chemical resistance, and thermal stability.
Choose TYPE E when your application demands maximum coverage and comprehensive isolation protection.

• Designed to fit only the raised face area of flanges
  • Provides reliable sealing and electrical insulation
  • The outside diameter of the gasket is slightly less than the inside diameter of the bolt circle
  • For best results, the flanges must be wrapped with Flange Band Protectors. So foreign materials are prevented from collecting and creating a bridge, thus shorting out the isolation
  • Ideal for high-pressure pipeline systems
  • Prevents galvanic corrosion between dissimilar metals
Choose TYPE F Insulation Gaskets when you need a compact, high-efficiency sealing solution tailored for raised face flange designs.

• Precisely fits RTJ flange grooves for optimal sealing
  • Provides strong electrical insulation and mechanical strength
  • Ideal for extreme pressure and temperature environments
  • Prevents leakage and flange corrosion
  • Available in Phenolic and G10 material types
  • Suitable for critical oil & gas, petrochemical, and power industry applications
For a robust, leak-proof, and electrically isolating solution in RTJ flange systems, TYPE D Insulation Gaskets deliver trusted performance and durability.

products_details.products_details_tilte: G10 / G11 with Viton / Spring energized Gaskets
products_details.products_details_descriptions:
• G10/G11: High-pressure insulating laminates known for their mechanical strength, thermal stability, and excellent electrical insulation.
  • Viton: A fluoroelastomer known for exceptional resistance to chemicals, oils, and heat, enhancing gasket durability and sealing capability.
  • Spring Energized Gaskets incorporate a flexible metallic spring core wrapped with a resilient sealing material such as PTFE or elastomers. This design maintains consistent sealing force even under fluctuating temperatures and pressures, ensuring leak-tight performance in dynamic conditions.
Features-
  • Maintains strong sealing force over a wide temperature range
  • Excellent chemical and abrasion resistance
  • We use a machined glass-reinforced epoxy (GRE) resin with an O-ring or spring-energized seal to produce this insulation set
  • These gaskets can be used for flange ratings from class 150 to 600
  • Improves compressive strength over conventional insulation sets
  • Provides greater resistance to over-compression and cracking
  • Ideal for applications with thermal cycling and mechanical vibrations
  • Provides long service life and reliable sealing in demanding conditions

products_details.products_details_tilte: Metal Core with G10 / G11 Gaskets
products_details.products_details_descriptions:
Metal Core Gaskets with G10/G11 Insulation combine the mechanical strength of a robust metal core with the excellent electrical insulation and chemical resistance of G10 or G11 laminate materials. The metal core provides structural support, ensuring the gasket maintains its shape and withstands high pressure and mechanical stress, while the G10/G11 layers prevent galvanic corrosion by electrically isolating flanged connections. Features:
  • Strong metal core for enhanced mechanical stability
  • High-quality G10/G11 insulation for excellent electrical isolation
  • Resistant to chemicals, heat, and pressure
  • Prevents galvanic corrosion in flanged joints with dissimilar metals
  • Suitable for harsh environments including oil & gas, petrochemical, and power industries
  • Highly reliable for both insulating and general sealing purposes in critical services
  • These gaskets have a proven track record of integrity in aggressive sealing situations
  • Suitable for all services up to and including ANSI 2500# and API 15,000# classes
  • Metal Core with G10/G11 gaskets consists of a PTFE (Teflon) spring-energized face seal, or an elastomeric o-ring
  • Accommodated in an insulating laminate that is permanently bonded to a high-strength metal gasket core.

acf.faq_title: Answers to all your possible questions.

faq_content.faq_answer: An insulation gasket is a sealing component installed between flanged joints to provide electrical isolation, prevent galvanic corrosion, and maintain a leak-tight seal in piping systems.

faq_content.faq_question: What is a flange insulation gasket used for?
faq_content.faq_answer: A flange insulation gasket is used to isolate flanged connections in pipelines, preventing electrical current flow between dissimilar metals and reducing the risk of corrosion and leakage.

faq_content.faq_question: What is included in a flange insulation gasket kit?
faq_content.faq_answer: A standard flange insulation gasket kit includes an insulation gasket, insulating sleeves, insulating washers, and steel backing washers required for proper flange isolation and installation.

faq_content.faq_question: Which flange standards are supported for insulation gasket kits?
faq_content.faq_answer: ASP flange insulation gasket kits are manufactured to suit ANSI, API, DIN, BS, AS, and MSSP standards, including ASME B16.5 Raised Face (RF), Full Face (FF), and RTJ flanges.

faq_content.faq_question: What materials are used for insulation gaskets?
faq_content.faq_answer: Insulation gaskets are made from non-metallic and laminated composite materials such as phenolic, neoprene-faced phenolic, G10/G11 glass epoxy, GRE, and PTFE, depending on operating conditions.

faq_content.faq_question: How do I select the right insulation gasket material?
faq_content.faq_answer: Selection depends on pressure rating, temperature, chemical exposure, flange type, and service conditions. ASP provides technical support to help choose the correct material.

faq_content.faq_question: Are flange insulation gasket kits suitable for high-pressure applications?
faq_content.faq_answer: Yes. Kits manufactured using laminated composite materials like G10/G11 are suitable for high-pressure and high-temperature industrial applications.

faq_content.faq_question: How thick is an insulation gasket?
faq_content.faq_answer: Thickness depends on flange standard, pressure class, and application requirements. Common thicknesses range from 1/16 inch (1.6 mm) to 1/4 inch (6.4 mm), with custom options available.

faq_content.faq_question: How do F, E, D, and O gasket isolation kits differ?
faq_content.faq_answer: F, E, D, and O gasket isolation kits differ in terms of their design and construction- the geometry, materials, and thickness of the insulating components. Each type is designed to meet specific industry standards and requirements, with varying levels of electrical insulation and corrosion resistance. (1) F-Type (Full Face) covers the entire flange face, including bolt holes. (2) E-Type fits inside the bolt circle (3) D-Type insulates the bore and flange face without bolt hole coverage. (4) O-Type provides bore-only insulation for specific applications

faq_content.faq_question: Can flange insulation gasket kits be customized?
faq_content.faq_answer: Yes. ASP offers custom flange insulation gasket kits based on flange type and size, pressure class, material requirements, and application specifications.
